solver.name: SLSQP
solver.choice_reason: Only installed usable optimizer;SciPy SLSQP. IPOPT bindings unavailable,no install performed;cannot claim faster than an unmeasured IPOPT.

implementation_interpretations.state/control: x=(x,y,unwrapped theta,v),u=(a,omega),N25,dt.1;actual saved pose/v fixed,first omega fixed to actual saved omega
implementation_interpretations.dynamics: Exact constant a/omega unicycle interval;state variables algebraically eliminated,50control unknowns;analytic chained Jacobians. Speed/SDF checked at all26nodes,terminal v25=0;no start relaxation.
implementation_interpretations.prior: All8world-fixed candidate suffixes after closest B projection;arc-length26point resampling within actual remaining length;do not discard short/zero-length candidates. Sum all26position errors/sigma.1 squared;minimum component active,lowest index tie.
implementation_interpretations.consistency: Immediately preceding sampled state in same run must have an EC-accepted U solution. Linear time alignment on overlapping horizon only,sigma.2;no extrapolation after previous horizon;missing/no solution clears prior.
implementation_interpretations.progress: Negative projection -(p25-p0) dot active candidate endpoint direction from B,weight1;no added desired progress length. Zero endpoint direction disables this term.
implementation_interpretations.clearance: sum(max(0,.15-d)/.05)^2;d already subtracts radius.09. Hard d>=.025 at26nodes. Field-domain inequalities only keep SDF queries inside recorded grid.
implementation_interpretations.initialization: 8candidate-derived bounded steering/control seeds + brake-to-stop + brake/rotate-left + brake/rotate-right;actual initial velocity retained;terminal braking seeds;no A* or oracle.
implementation_interpretations.EC: Direct frozen Phase52EC braking-tail certify on Graph XY using actual saved pose/v/omega and frozen PP/SP. Graph v/omega are NOT followed by this EC. Exact stationary center and zero velocities use endpoint controller with the same EC;circle footprint invariant,including in-place rotation. No epsilon path.
implementation_interpretations.selection: Lowest objective among hard-feasible final iterates that pass independent EC;check sorted final iterates until firstPASS. Convergence status separately reported;hard-feasible nonconverged iterates can be accepted. Tolerance1e-7;no kinematic relaxation.
implementation_interpretations.sampling: All four requested development cohorts,144runs,max40uniform ordinal arrivals/run. Select before map check. Latest published snapshot at latch time must physically exist;no older substitute. NIGHT225/226 forbidden.
implementation_interpretations.comparison: Actual mode and installed path at same arrival time. Side=end lateral offset relative current robot heading;deadband1cm. Adjacent sampled pairs common to accepted U and recorded path only;not full4Hz reversal rate.
implementation_interpretations.types: Travel<=1mm:rotation>1mrad=>in-place rotation,otherwiseSTOP;moving with first a0*v0<-1e-7=>DECEL,otherwiseFORWARD/MOVE;reverse velocity flag always reported because |v| allows reverse.
implementation_interpretations.offline_limit: Saved actual starting states,one fixed2.5s path/snapshot;previous U never physically executed;no new NoMaD/depth/physics. Next2.5s actual trace is visual comparison only.
